Contract:
`AX_SPEC_TABLE_IS_INDEX` (v2, `shared/sdd/check.ts`): a table is an index, not text — `Purpose` is one short line (checked: ≤120 chars, one sentence, no `
`); anything longer moves to that entity's `### ` block in Entity Surfaces, not into this cell.
```markdown ## Entity Inventory
_Это полный список сущностей модуля. Любое введение сущности execution-агентом помимо этого списка считается drift'ом и требует обновления spec._
| Name | Type | Purpose | |------|------|---------| | `OrderProcessor` | Service | Композитная обработка lifecycle заказа | | `PaymentGatewayPort` | Port | Абстракция для списания средств | | `StripePaymentAdapter` | Adapter | Реализация PaymentGatewayPort через Stripe | ```
**Errors ownership is first-class**, not an afterthought: either one row above is the explicit errors owner (its `Purpose` says so, e.g. «Владеет обработкой/показом ошибок платежа»), or the inventory carries one extra line right under the table:
```markdown Ошибки: <механизм — throw | Result | event | …> → <владелец: EntityName> ```
A BDD ticket downstream cannot require behavior on an error whose owner is absent from this inventory — that gap is caught here, before approval, not discovered later at scaffold time.
**ER sketch — mandatory once ≥2 entities are relationally connected** (one references, owns, or is composed of another): the table alone shows WHAT exists, not HOW the entities relate, and a relationship among ≥2 elements is exactly the case a picture beats a paragraph (`AX_INFOGRAPHIC_FIRST`, `formats/diagram-vocabulary.xml`). Add it directly under the table:
```markdown Order ──1:N──▶ OrderLine - id (PK) - id (PK) - customerId - orderId (FK) ```
A single-entity inventory (nothing to relate) or a set of genuinely unrelated entities skips the sketch — state which case applies, never leave the reader guessing. This ASCII form is shown in chat during the STEP_2_ENTITY_INVENTORY interview, at the point the entities and their relations are confirmed (`AX_CHAT_BEFORE_SPEC`); the mermaid `erDiagram` version below the table is the same shape, not a fresh diagram invented at write time.
